mutations.name: retires a report that is not final
kills: retire at the final report keeps an agent whose last report is "Status: BLOCKED", since a retired name cannot be resumed

mutations.name: retires without the Shepherd hold
kills: retire at the final report keeps an agent whose branch a Shepherd hold names

mutations.name: retires through a refused park
kills: retire at the final report keeps the agent with the park's reason when the park refuses

mutations.name: retires without the late check
kills: retire at the final report keeps an agent resumed while the park ran

mutations.name: retires an agent of a spawner that did not opt in
kills: retire at the final report does nothing for a spawner that did not opt in
